article.title: Israel’s violence against Palestine survives the ceasefire: The Forty-First Newsletter (2026)
article.author: Vijay Prashad
article.content: The assault on Palestinian existence is not confined to bombardment. The destruction of infrastructure, Israeli control over Palestinian money, and Western corporate complicity in apartheid are interconnected fronts of the same offensive.
